selection: Eight new configurations. Accuracy policy also permits the cached baseline selection. Rank by pooled inner correct count, macro-F1, then fixed order. No outer or validation tuning.
features: Original 384 MiniLM plus 128 audio/visual summaries; no demographic, questionnaire, PHQ-score or label features.
architecture: Soft binary group gate with conditional multinomial heads. Boundary zero: class 0 versus 1-4. Boundary one: classes 0-1 versus 2-4. Multiply group probability by within-group probability; no thresholds or calibration.
preprocessing: Each node fits its own StandardScaler/PCA on its fitting participants only. Conditional heads see only their branch fitting participants. Square-root inverse class weights are computed separately inside each node. No synthetic observations.
evaluation: Original 5 outer x 3 inner folds and seeds 42/137/2026. All 163 participants retained. Exploratory after extensive reuse; no new official validation or test scoring. Final selection uses saved inner predictions only.
uncertainty: 5000 paired participant bootstrap samples; all three predictions for a participant travel together. Conditional on fitted models, pointwise, not adjusted for historical search or overlapping training sets.
stopping_rule: One new approach, eight configurations, fifteen outer jobs, at most two final pipeline fits. Do not expand the grid in response to results.
